_comment: The passive service catalog of the Icinga turn-key flow. add-icinga-bundle.ps1 turns each entry into a scheduler schedule on channel ICINGA (the entry name becomes the schedule name, which IcingaClient submits as the Icinga service name), setup-icinga-machine.ps1 derives the freshness window (3 x interval) from the interval, and verify-icinga-estate.ps1 waits for a passive result on every entry. The name host_check is special: IcingaClient submits it as the result of the host itself, not as a service. Only commands that exist on both Windows and Linux belong here.
